violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: chicken salad sandwich (44F) stored in True 2 UR refrigerator with multiple canned sodas and alcoholic beverage.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM removed some of the beverages from the refrigerator to improve ventilation airflow throughout the unit. EHS instructed CFM to check if the temperature of chicken salad is still 41F or below once transported from the main kitchen and re-cool in the Avantico 2 Dr preptop refrigerator if needed.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: The CFM was unable to provide proof of an Employee Health policy in place.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided the Employee Health policy documentation to the CFM , by email, for compliance.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided the vomit and diarrhea clean up procedures to the CFM, by email, for compliance.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: milk in carafe on the countertop
violations.corrective_action: The CFM marked the carafe with the 4 hour time parameter for compliance.

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): milk in carafes on countertop
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided the TPHC documentation for the milk in the carafes, by email, for compliance.
